BiblicalUsage: maqhêl is an assembly or congregation, and it occurs twice, both times in the Psalms. In Psalms 26:12 the psalmist says in the congregations he will bless the LORD, and in Psalms 68:26 the call is to bless God in the congregations, from the fountain of Israel. The word is God's people gathered to bless Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe maqhêl shows me that blessing God is a congregational act, and I hold that my praise is fullest when it joins the assembly.
